caption_en:
Every country has an ikigai: what it loves, what it's good at, what the world needs, and what it gets paid for.

Some call Israel a colonizer. It fails every circle. Israel gave back Sinai to Egypt (peace treaty 1979, withdrawal 1982): about 60,000 km², almost three times Israel's 22,072 km².

What fits: research and tech. Israel spends 6.8% of GDP on R&D, the highest in the OECD (OECD MSTI, March 2026 release, 2024 data). High tech is 56.4% of Israel's exports (Israel Innovation Authority, 2024).

The neighbours, each with its own centre:
🇸🇦 Saudi Arabia: energy. Oil is 73.1% of exports (GASTAT, 2024). Vision 2030 is building a non-oil economy.
🇦🇪 UAE: the world's stopover. Dubai International is No. 1 for international passengers, 95.2M in 2025 (ACI World).
🇪🇬 Egypt: history and the Suez Canal. A record 15.7M tourists in 2024 (Ministry of Tourism).
🇹🇷 Türkiye: making things. Record $262B of exports in 2024 (Trade Ministry), plus TV dramas sold worldwide.
🇯🇴 Jordan: hospitality. Petra, one of the New 7 Wonders (2007), and JD 7.2B tourism income in 2024 (Central Bank of Jordan).

A country is what it builds, not what it's called.

Photos (Wikimedia Commons): Zvi Roger (CC BY 3.0); B.alotaby (CC BY-SA 4.0); Chris Olszewski (CC BY-SA 4.0); Aah-Yeah (CC BY 2.0); SegLig (CC BY 4.0); Vyacheslav Argenberg (CC BY 4.0). AI voice.
Send this to someone who builds.
caption_he:
לכל מדינה יש איקיגאי: מה היא אוהבת, במה היא טובה, מה העולם צריך, ועל מה משלמים לה.
יש מי שקורא לישראל "קולוניאליסטית". זה נכשל בכל עיגול: ישראל החזירה את סיני, כמעט פי שלושה מגודלה.
מה כן מתאים: מחקר וטכנולוגיה. 6.8% מהתוצר הולכים למו"פ, המקום הראשון ב־OECD. ההייטק הוא 56% מהיצוא.
ולשכנות יש מרכז משלהן: סעודיה, אנרגיה. האמירויות, תחנת המעבר של העולם. מצרים, היסטוריה ותעלת סואץ. טורקיה, תעשייה. ירדן, הכנסת אורחים ופטרה.
מדינה היא מה שהיא בונה, לא איך שקוראים לה.

lines.line: What you love, what you're good at, what the world needs, what pays.
Some call Israel a colonizer. Drop it in.
Love it? Israelis can't agree on a government, never mind an empire.
Good at it? Israel gave back Sinai, almost three times its size.
World needs it? No. Paid for it? No.
What fits? Research. Six point eight percent of GDP, number one in the OECD.
Tech is fifty six percent of exports. Israel's ikigai: building things.
Saudi Arabia: energy. The world needs it and pays: oil is seventy three percent of exports.
The UAE: the world's stopover. Dubai, the busiest international airport on Earth.
Egypt: history and the Suez Canal. A record fifteen point seven million tourists.
Turkey: making things. Two hundred sixty two billion dollars of exports, plus TV dramas.
Jordan: hospitality. Petra, a wonder of the world, and over seven billion dinars from tourism.
A country is what it builds, not what it's called.
